title: I Love You So
lyrics:
[00:13.35]I just need someone in my life to give it structure
[00:19.49]To handle all the selfish ways I spend my time without her
[00:25.80]You're everything I want, but I can't deal with all your lovers
[00:32.23]You're saying I'm the one, but it's your actions that speak louder
[00:38.69]Giving me love when you are down and need another
[00:44.78]I've got to get away and let you go, I've got to get over
[00:51.10]But I love you so
[00:57.56]I love you so
[01:03.88]I love you so
[01:10.19]I love you so
[01:14.57]I'm gonna pack my things and leave you behind
[01:20.82]This feeling's old, and I know that I've made up my mind
[01:27.16]I hope you feel what I felt when you shattered my soul
[01:33.45]'Cause you were cruel, and I'm a fool
[01:37.02]So please let me go
[01:41.57]But I love you so (Please let me go)
[01:48.06]I love you so (Please let me go)
[01:54.41]I love you so (Please let me go)
[02:00.74]I love you so
